вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, as a matter of fact, for the record
meanings.note: Polite or pointed correction. Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'обще-то'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Меня вообще-то Юля зовут. Вот сахар.
examples.trans: My name is actually Yulia. Here's the sugar.

Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'метить'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to notice', forming an aspectual pair with 'замечать'.

examples.text: Никто на кухне ничего не заметил.
examples.trans: Nobody in the kitchen noticed anything.

meanings.en: name, title (of an object, place, or dish)

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
